prompt:
Create a NEW cute pixel-art game character sprite atlas: MIDORI, a WHITE SILKIE HEN. She MUST instantly read as a CHICKEN, not an owl, sheep, furball, poodle or a baby chick.
Avian silhouette: small head on a visible short curved neck, pear-shaped torso, TWO clearly defined folded FEATHERED WINGS, short raised feather fan TAIL, two legs ending in distinct dark gray chicken toes. Small fluffy feather CREST on TOP of head only, not covering eyes or swallowing whole head. Both eyes fully visible, small charcoal face patch, short clearly projecting golden pointed BEAK, tiny burgundy comb and small burgundy wattle beneath beak. White/ivory plumage with subtle warm feather shading, not round wool blobs. Feathery ankles, but visible two feet/toes. Kind lively eyes and a little confident smile. Round appealing forms, clean dark pixel contours and deliberate pixel clusters. Not glossy and not realistic. She is an ADULT HEN, with a neck and tail. No fur, no mammal muzzle, no accessories.
Transparent animation sprite sheet: EXACT8ROWS×8COLUMNS=64 whole birds, equalcells broad transparentgutters, no shadows/text/ground. All body parts inside eachcell.
Rows=8FIXED VIEW ANGLES: FRONT(S), FRONT-LEFT(SW), LEFT PROFILE(W), BACK-LEFT(NW), STRAIGHT BACK(N), BACK-RIGHT(NE), RIGHT PROFILE(E), FRONT-RIGHT(SE). Each row preserves SAME torso/head angle for ALL eight columns. NO turnarounds within a row. Row5 NO face visible anywhere. Row3 ALL beaks left, row7 ALL beaks right.
Each row 8-frame balanced TWO-FOOT walk: contact left, downleft, passing right, up, contact right, downright, passing left, up. Planted foot moves back then lifted foot bends and steps forward, no limb loss. Body size and wings stay stable, subtle feather/crest followthrough. Crisp polished pixel art at 48-60pixels gameheight.
